pages.title: How do you say how are you in Hindi?
pages.h1: How do you say how are you in Hindi?
pages.description: आप कैसे हैं? (aap kaise hain?) to a man and आप कैसी हैं? (aap kaisi hain?) to a woman. To a friend, क्या हाल है? (kya haal hai?) — same phrase for everyone.
